{{- /* {{% props %}}: the page's Props table, generated at build time (see props-markdown.html). Call it with % delimiters so the table goes through the Markdown renderer and render-table.html, like any authored table. With no data file (a local build without the SDK api model) it prints a note, and warns once per build. In CI the generator fails first when a page's symbols have no public props. */ -}} {{- with partial "props-markdown.html" .Page -}} {{ . | safeHTML }} {{- else -}} {{- if (partialCached "api-data.html" .Page .Page.Section).props -}} {{- errorf "props: %s has {{%% props %%}} but none of its api_symbols has a Props table" .Page.File.Path -}} {{- else -}} {{- if not (hugo.Store.Get "propsNoDataWarned") -}} {{- hugo.Store.Set "propsNoDataWarned" true -}} {{- warnf "props: no data/api_props.json, so {{%% props %%}} pages show a note instead of their table. Build the API reference first (make api-reference)." -}} {{- end -}} _The props table is generated with the API reference, which this build doesn't include._ {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
